title: Cardamom and Zante Currant Syrup

items: ¼ cup Zante currants, coarsely chopped

steps: Pound the whole cardamom to release the seeds.
Combine the sugar, hot water, cardamom pods and seeds, and currants in a pot. Heat over medium heat for 20 minutes.
Remove from the heat and allow to cool. Refrigerate for up to two days, then strain and bottle for cocktails.
